content: Tana ecore angmǝ azaa ondo ne
“Tana e core angmǝ azaa ondo ne, adorana tana a core angmǝ azaa oying ne.
Nangka e core angmǝ azaa na ondo, nyimia ayo core angmǝ aza oying. Kangza ka epa ogoshe ooka e ezane, ka wai ya ayo eza ying ne.
“Eyaka oya gonta kapa a liizi le orone o, oota ba laka okuturu a liizi leo ne?
Ba wǝnia o bekaa orone o na, ‘Bayang lopau kapa a nyimi liizi leo,’ abo oya ka okuturu a liizi leo?
Bo ondo ara ukpwei, bora ka o lope okuturu a liizi leo, arakaname oyo laka maleu ko ama o lopa kapa a liizi le orone o.
“Tana e nya e'ere epa e sangsang ne, tana e tare odembashe akwilǝ acale edang aying ne. Nee era ne itǝzǝ ne ka tobona, ane kuri kane daare ying a lekeleke.”
O beya angmǝ ka Ashili
“Pirǝ na ayo nya ying, geraza na eyo cǝ, gwarazana ayo pari ying abuudu.
Pate ondooka wa pirǝ ayo nya wai, ondooka wa gera wayo cǝ, kangza pate ondooka wa gwara, ayo pari wai abuudu.
Mana nyimi oying ana ate, kena ka wai ka bosa oborode, awa nya kai lecale?
Koona ka bose bekwala, awa nya kai owa?
Na ying ana ara aburu e rose nangka eyo nyaza ayana ying mapapa ma rere, shebari Ate aying o zaa shili wato kala ying aa ama o nyaza mapapa ma rere andaaka ne pirzi ai sang!
Azaa nyimi, eza aromo epaaka oya yeme ane ezo, obena ennaa beyo be makili ma Mosa ka ana obeya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili.”
Abuudu a seto
Lyǝ na abuudu a seto. Obena abuudu a patarke kaa kang gongha a aleze ka aromo akwilǝ ola, aromo a cake lyǝzǝ a ai.
Nyimia orona o cǝsǝ ebeene o dera o maro, waya seto awa kang ya baate, andaa baate ya kalea ai.
A rose uti ka ebelo ayana wai
“Ezana a sauwo ka ana beya angmǝ ka mawo rendaza. Ne deese aying ka madibi ma emande epeng, a nyimi one neye na enama orambo o kala ara aburu.
Ebelo ogole ane wayo ote ka rose ne. Ara cǝ ayana inabi
uti ekana na, koona ayana osaya a uti ekana?
Nyimia konang uti orere wa kareze ayana rere, aa uti oburu wa kareze ayana aburu.
Uti orere wa era wata kare ayana aburu ne, anyimia kangza uti oburu wa era wata kare ayana aa rere ne.
Pate uti ka wata kare ayana aa rere ne, ayo core wai a tare wai a nyimi ola.
Nyimia ayana ane yo ote ka erose ne.”
Anta maa tukǝ o rosa oying ne
Pate ondooka wa beya mi na, ‘Ateokora, Ateokora’ waya to lyǝ a nyimi togomo to zaa shili ne. Soona ondooka wa eza epaaka Ate ang o nyimia o zaa shili ya yeme me.

A lengme lenname aromo acake yo beya me na, ‘Ateokora, Ateokora!’ Cai! Te zoole aa nyimi leze leo sang? Te sǝrsǝzǝ mabere maa buru anyimi leze leo sang? Kangza, a nyimi leze leo wa te eze mapapa mo tera ukpwei sang?
A were namea eyang bekaa ne a begeshe be komana na, ‘Anta tukǝ orosa oying ne. Arnang na ka me, ying ana o eza epa e buru.’
Aromo leere ana osowa
“Azaa nyimi pate ondooka wa kona angmǝ ang aana, ka wa eze ogole ka ai, waye na ondoo rosa ka wa sowa akwilǝ wai azaa opoo.
Nangka olyi wa ngmeze, na mabeno penze a ngmet, obere kang era nawa tabe akwilǝ me, nyimia na ata oko ne, obena oting ai ya azaa opoo.
A pate ondooka wa kona a ngmǝ ang aana, ka wata eza ogole ka ai ne, waye na ondoo dera orosa ka wa so akwilǝ azaa egengge.
Na olyi ngmeze, a mabeno penze, kangza obere ere nawa tabe akwilǝ name, naa oko a nyokonyoko.”
Nangka Yeso ka mare o beya mapapa ma name, na epame tere leguki le aromo ukpwei azaa ambela obaala kai.
Azaa obena ka baale ne naa ondooka waye ka obare, na ana o baala makili ma Mosa tazane.
